scripts.copy-static: mkdir -p dist/tabbar dist/assets dist/main/mcp && cp src/tabbar/tabbar.html src/tabbar/tabbar.css dist/tabbar/ && cp assets/offline.html dist/assets/ && cp src/main/mcp/toolManifest.json dist/main/mcp/
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run copy-static
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:bench: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.bench.config.ts
